skill.summary: Manage multiple SaaS startups simultaneously with CEO-driven orchestration, product agents, ChatDev code generation, and a 3-Gate BUILD, TEST, JUDGE pipeline.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Dark Factory Multi-Agent Startup Platform.

- Enables parallel SaaS startup development using specialized agents and a CEO orchestrator
- Implements a 3-Gate Pipeline: BUILD, TEST, JUDGE for robust quality control
- Integrates ChatDev for automated, multi-agent code generation
- Includes L6 continuous self-improvement with several feedback loops
- Supports quick setup with OpenClaw and configurable product agents
